comment: Returns elastic and plastic section properties of a simple polygon as a 27×3 array of name, value, and unit. vertices is an n×2 array in vertex order, column 1 x and column 2 y, with no repeated closing vertex. Ixx and Iyy are centroidal second moments. Ixy is the centroidal product of inertia. Iuu is the major principal moment and the angle is that axis from the x-axis, in degrees. Zxx and Zyy are the smaller elastic moduli. Sxx and Syy are the plastic moduli about the equal-area axes. unit defaults to mm and labels the units only. A zero-area polygon returns #DIV/0!. Fewer than two columns returns #VALUE!. Non-numeric coordinates return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
